manifests.contents:
[workspace]
members = ["app-one", "lib-shared"]
resolver = "2"

[workspace.dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0"
features = ["derive"]

[workspace.dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.0"
features = ["rt", "rt-multi-thread", "macros"]

[[bin]]
path = "src/main.rs"
name = "app-one"
plugin = false
proc-macro = false
edition = "2021"
required-features = []

[package]
name = "app-one"
edition = "2021"
version = "0.0.1"

[dependencies.lib-shared]
path = "../lib-shared"

[dependencies.serde]
workspace = true

[package]
name = "lib-shared"
edition = "2021"
version = "0.0.1"

[dependencies.serde]
workspace = true

[lib]
path = "src/lib.rs"
name = "lib_shared"
plugin = false
proc-macro = false
edition = "2021"
required-features = []
crate-type = ["lib"]
